<function name="GetMorphTex1" parent="render" type="libraryfunc">
	<realm>Client</realm>
	<description>
<internal>You probably want to just use a custom render target. See <page>Global.GetRenderTargetEx</page>.</internal>

Returns the second render target texture that was used internally for Morph post processing effect.

See <page>render.GetMorphTex0</page> for more information..
</description>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="ITexture">The render target texture named `s_pMorphTexture1`.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
